thread:
Maya R: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — proposing a small process tweak to make action items actually close instead of lingering. Thoughts?

Liam C: yes please. current spreadsheet gets stale. we need ownership + SLA + auto reminders.

Sophia K: Agree. What SLAs are we thinking? 72h for triage, 2 weeks for remediation?

Maya R: Draft proposal:
- Owner assigned on postmortem publish (not 'team')
- Triage note + mitigation plan within 72 hours
- Full remediation or scoped RFC within 14 days (extendable with approval)
- Automation: bot creates tasks in tracker and pings owner at 48h/10d/13d

Alex P: +1 on automation. Can we have recurring incident pattern detection feed into this so repeat-root incidents get priority?

Ben S: we should also distinguish 'monitoring fixes' vs 'code fixes' for SLAs. monitoring/instrumentation often quicker.

Maya R: good call. split the action_types: [monitoring, config, infra, code, docs]. SLAs by type.

oncall-bot: FYI, I can create a follow-up card template:
```
Title: PM follow-up - <incident id>
Owner: <user>
Type: <monitoring|config|infra|code|docs>
Due: <iso-date>
Status: Open
Links: <postmortem link>
```

Liam C: timeline template suggestion (for postmortem doc header):
```
- T0: incident start
- T+30m: initial comms sent
- T+1h: incident commander assigned
- T+6h: mitigation in place or rollback
- T+24h: incident triage summary
- T+72h: postmortem draft
- T+14d: remediation target
```

Sophia K: I like explicit incident-commander rotation notes. propose weekly on-call IC rotation and backup IC for each incident. avoids single point of knowledge.

Alex P: operationally, how do we rotate? do we take from oncall schedule or a separate IC roster?

Maya R: propose: primary IC = current oncall, backup = previous oncall. If oncall unavailable, paging policy applies. Also have a 2-week IC handover checklist.

Ben S: checklist idea:
- Handover doc link
- Active mitigations + runbooks touched
- Current follow-ups + owners
- Communication channels to update

Maya R: communications cadence I propose:
- Incident open: post to #incidents (auto) and squad channel
- 30m update: quick status in incident thread
- 2h update: if ongoing, summary + next steps
- Postmortem draft: within 72h to triage readers
- Final postmortem: within 7 days after review

Liam C: small ask: add a 'reoccurrence score' field in postmortem so PMs can prioritize. 0-5 scale.

Sophia K: and add 'customer impact' tag (low/med/high) so infra backlog triage picks up high-impact ones faster.

oncall-bot: automation notes:
- create card on publish, assign owner if provided else assign to oncall and ping
- send 48h reminder to owner and their manager
- if overdue at 13d, escalate to SRE tech lead and product oncall

Alex P: where should we track these? prefer we use our issue tracker (Jira) with a stable label and link back to postmortem. spreadsheet ok short-term but not ideal.

Maya R: agreed. plan: create Jira "PM-followup" issue type. bot will create ticket. postmortem will embed link to ticket.

Ben S: suggest a lightweight audit table for weekly reviews: columns [incident id, owner, due, status, reoccurrence score, notes]. can be a saved Jira filter + dashboard.

Liam C: can we add a small rubric for 'closure criteria' so owners know when to close? e.g., deploy + monitor 2x incident window and no regression, docs updated, runbook updated.

Sophia K: +1 on closure rubric. also require a short 'lessons learned' blurb (1-3 bullets) on the follow-up ticket.

Maya R: I'll draft a one-pager and a timeline template to drop into the postmortem template and set up a Jira issue type. plan to pilot for the next 4 incidents then iterate.

Alex P: sounds good. :thumbsup: happy to help with Jira workflow and automation.

oncall-bot: Created checklist template draft in #eng-oncall pinned messages (link: https://redwood.fake/pin/pm-followup-template)

Maya R: thanks all. assigning action: Maya R -> create draft + Jira config by EOD Friday. Alex P -> automation wiring. Liam C -> closure rubric draft. Sophia K -> review pilot incidents. Ben S -> dashboard filter.

Liam C: acked.

Sophia K: ack.

Alex P: ack, will start on automation playbook tomorrow.

Ben S: acked, will make dashboard.

Maya R: closing loop — will post the finalized doc and the pilot checklist next week. :rocket:
